texts.zh:
[event_envoy.GetName]，我们派遣到[envoy_country.GetName]的特使，似乎有些被他们同化了。在过去的几个月中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]经常表达对[envoy_country.GetAdj]国家体制的赞美，与[Root.GetGovernmentName]内的僵化和缺乏自由形成了鲜明的对比。
“我亲眼可见他们的政府在倾听人民的呼声，”据传[event_envoy.GetSheHe]最近有说道。“事实上，我自己很难想象出一个更好的体制了。”

这一发现促使人们动议将[event_envoy.GetHerHim]召回，使[event_envoy.GetSheHe]能够回归到正统的[Root.GetAdj]行为准则上。然而，另一种观点则认为，拥有一位与能够理解与我们差异巨大的对手的外交人员在紧张的外交局势中将会有好处。
texts.en:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Over the last few months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] often seemed to admire the [envoy_country.GetAdj] governmental system, favorably contrasting the liberties enjoyed there with the rigidity and lack of freedom within the [Root.GetGovernmentName].
"I can well see the appeal of delegating government to the People," [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetWasWere] recently heard to say. "In fact, I could scarcely imagine a better system myself."

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.

"If lesser liberty is the price of an efficient government, then perhaps that is a price worth paying," [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetWasWere] recently heard to say.

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.

texts.en:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Bizarrely, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] taken to agreeing with [envoy_country.GetAdj] distrust of the alien, calling for measures to prevent alleged xeno exploitation of [Root.GetAdj] hospitality. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] responded that, having seen the benefits of a more orderly society in [envoy_country.Capital.GetName], returning to the chaos and lawlessness of [Root.Capital.GetName] would be difficult indeed.

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.
